# Fortune Insight shop

> English-first shop for indie iOS teams: App Store listing rewrites, weekly App Store policy and fee notes (EU, US, Asia), and a Ship-from-Asia ops pack. Seller: Fortune Insight, LLC.

The live shop is https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/ (English homepage).
Chinese storefront: https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/zh.html
Free sample of Storefront Brief is also on Telegram: https://t.me/storefrontbrief

## Products

- AppLocale: one-time $79 rewrite of one live App Store listing into English and Chinese (title, subtitle, keywords, description). Paste into App Store Connect. No ranking promise. After checkout, reply from the Stripe receipt with App Store URL and existing copy.
- Storefront Brief: $12/month weekly App Store policy and fee notes for indie iOS teams shipping internationally (EU, US, Asia). Operator intel — not trading signals. Latest issue: https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/brief/issue-008-en.html · Free samples: https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/brief/issue-007-en.html · https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/brief/issue-006-en.html · https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/brief/issue-005-en.html · https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/brief/issue-003-en.html · https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/brief/issue-003.html (ZH) · https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/brief/issue-002-en.html · https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/brief/issue-001-en.html · https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/brief/issue-000-en.html · https://fortune-insight.onrender.com/shop/brief/issue-000.html · Telegram: https://t.me/storefrontbrief
- Ship from Asia pack: $29 one-time operator pack for shipping iOS from Asia.
